blockingIssues.description: packages/coding-agent/src/prompts/tools.yaml still gives contradictory spawn_agent guidance by both telling the model to use wait_agent after spawning and saying wait_agent should be used explicitly only for parallel child sessions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the core-runtime-worker guidance so a scrutiny rerun for a previously reported validator gap must strengthen coverage or the prompt/contract text for that exact gap instead of relying on a pre-existing loose assertion that merely checks for keywords.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The re-review for core-validator-blockers-outside-mcp found that worker session b3df0e19-6a01-40f9-b44c-b02639ceaac0 declared the feature fixed after removing stale /autohandoff handling, while packages/coding-agent/test/wait-agent.red.test.ts:122-126 still passed despite the contradictory spawn_agent/wait_agent text remaining at packages/coding-agent/src/prompts/tools.yaml:234-238.
